answer: Sybil resistance here is stake-backed identity on a trust graph. Each agent is one vertex, allowed a single vote only after locking a bond; weight also needs a vine of attestations from older staked agents, so a fresh fake account starts at zero. Collateral is the ledge that makes defection costly: to buy k votes an attacker must post k bonds and bribe k distinct attestors, and a caught double-sign slashes every linked bond at once. Cost rises per forged identity while any cheat forfeits the whole stake.
